title: Derived source restriction commutes with arbitrary upper-square units
statement:
theorem derivedSourceRestriction_unit_naturality
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ X) (p : T' ⟶ X') (v : T' ⟶ T)
    (hv : v ≫ t = p ≫ g') :
    let c := fun {A B C : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) (t : B ⟶ C) ↦
      relativeMVComp s t
    let a := fun {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) ↦ relativeMVAdj s
    let k := conjugateIsoEquiv (a (t ≫ f)) ((a f).comp (a t)) (c t f)
    let k' := conjugateIsoEquiv (a (p ≫ f')) ((a f').comp (a p)) (c p f')
    let b := schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (t ≫ f) (p ≫ f') g v
      (by rw [← Category.assoc, hv, Category.assoc, h, ← Category.assoc])
      ((derivedPullback t).obj K) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (p ≫ f')).map
        ((c v t).hom.app K ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun s ↦ (derivedPullback s).obj K) hv) ≫
          (c p g').inv.app K ≫ (derivedPullback p).map φ)
    (derivedPullback g).map
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map ((a t).unit.app K) ≫
          k.inv.app ((derivedPullback t).obj K)) ≫
      b =
    (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h K ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map φ) ≫
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map ((a p).unit.app K') ≫
        k'.inv.app ((derivedPullback p).obj K'))

proof.text: Transpose under the composite adjunction for the two target-side arrows. The conjugate comparison converts transposition under their composite to successive transposition. Expand the base-change counit formula. Associativity of the pinned pullback comparisons identifies the two paths around the commuting square. Naturality moves the inserted source unit next to its counit, where the triangle identity cancels it. Naturality of the target unit moves the coefficient morphism to the last factor. Injectivity of the hom equivalence gives the equality. This is the complete Lean calculation generalized from singleComplexOpenComparison_unit_naturality, with an arbitrary commuting upper square in place of the chosen open pullback.
